screens.name: START HERE / Phase 6 product design expansion
text: Phase 6 reopened · AI, agents, collaboration and a deeper inspector
The previous prototype covered representative scenarios. Product design coverage remains under review; these are proposed native Figma workflows, not live service results.
19 states · class/cascade, responsive origins, box model, grid, typography, appearance, semantics and interactions.
12 states · element/page/site scope, prompt, proposal review, apply/undo, stale context, errors and quota.
15 states · task permissions, plan approval, running/cancel/failure, partial results, audit logs and read-only site audit.
16 states · presence, site roles, comments, pinned reviews, invitations, offline changes and conflict resolution.

73 original scenarios: I 19 · A 12 · G 15 · C 16 · T 11.
R26 adds connected type tabs, workspace overlays and recovery scenarios. Page 02 owns detailed screen coverage; page 03 owns controls; this page owns integrated product journeys. Runtime/source verification remains open.
